versions.changelog:
product-dev-workflow-v5 1.0.0

- Initial release of the “产品开发全流程AI辅助工作流” skill.
- Enables one-step, structured Markdown report generation covering six key stages: 需求分析, 技术调研, 方案设计, 物料选型, 测试分析, GTM上市策略.
- Strict input/output protocols defined; triggers automatically on product development inquiries.
- Tailored for early-stage R&D of industrial products such as sensors, instrumentation, and smart hardware.
- Ensures traceability, consistency, and comprehensive content for each development phase, in Chinese.
